## D.9 Physical /status contract

```text
MISSION
  id / phase / goal / last_progress

WORKUNITS
  ready / running / blocked / verified / failed

PROVIDERS
  resident / active / queued / health / context / throughput

EXTERNAL TASKS
  admitted / active / queued / terminal / failed / throttled

CPU / TOOLS
  active / queued

VERIFICATION
  active / backlog / pass / fail

MUTATION
  owner / waiters / lease age

REPAIR
  active chains / max depth / exhausted

PERSISTENCE
  generation / checkpoint age / digest

THROUGHPUT
  verified WU/hour / marginal trend

RESOURCE
  GPU / CPU / RAM / swap / disk / I/O / benchmark qualification

STAGNATION
  no-progress tier / current reason
```
